title: Mystery of the Arcadian Ruins
description: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.

mainQuestExcel.title: Mystery of the Arcadian Ruins
mainQuestExcel.description: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.

flow.stepDescription: Meet with the informant at the designated location
Defeat the opponents attacking the informant

dialogs.text: Why is this happening to me? I shouldn't have helped <color=#00E1FFFF>him</color>...
Him, who?
Thanks so much for saving me! You're far more reliable than those Favonius guys.
#It's nothing. {M#He}{F#She}'s a traveler, {M#he}{F#she} has to deal with stuff like this all the time.
Traveler? I've heard stories about you. I didn't think I'd be saved by <color=#00E1FFFF>the one I'm here to meet</color>.
Oh, so you're the...
Hahaha... I didn't know how I could pay you back initially, but now, I think I'll just give you the intel for free.
People in our circle know how important the network is.
Really?
Well, you did save my life.
LUCKY!
But... it's lucky for Kaeya, isn't it? He's supposed to pay for the intel...
Listen well then, the intel on the Arcadian Ruins...
"Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure."
Right... Wait, is that it?
There's also this map that came with it.
Could... this be the X-marks-the-spot?
So the clue is more like a riddle...
#Well, should be a piece of cake for ya, right {NICKNAME}? Paimon'll leave it to you then!
Sure thing.
Well, if you can't solve it, we can ask Kaeya. He seems like a nerd too.
I'll leave you the intel so you can review it at any time.
Thanks, Vile.
"Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure."
What does that mean? If you don't wanna ask Kaeya, you better figure it out!
Sure... I hope.
Thank you, friend.
"Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure." Got it?

flow.stepDescription: Find the location of the buried treasure

dialogs.text: Ooh, lemme see what's inside!
"She doesn't love him at all. The passion rushing through the clear spring is just a front. When she's cold and alone, her true heart is revealed."
There's another map.
More riddles?
Paimon's dizzy already. Oh, no! Paimon used up all her brain juice!
You never had any to begin with...
Paimon'll let you have all the fun. Or, you could get Kaeya to help.

flow.stepDescription: Disappears after controlling Paimon to talk

flow.stepDescription: Solve the mystery (Go to Kaeya at the Knights of Favonius HQ for a hint)

dialogs.text: #{NICKNAME}! You're back! Looks like you got the intel.
Yes and no. It's a lot more complicated than that.
"Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure." What do you make of it?
Riddles? How quaint. Let me think...
"City in the lake" is clearly Mondstadt... As for the Six-Armed Giants... Hmm...
Crabs?
Giant crabs!
Aside from asking just where we would find giant crabs...
Crabs have eight legs, not six...
The windmills, then?
Should be... the windmills?
Hey! That's smart!
A windmill has six blades... It fits.
Wow! That makes sense!
So, out of the three windmills, two are close to the statue...
The other one is guarding...
Ooh! Ooh! This one Paimon knows! The treasure!
Hehehe... Let's hope it's really that simple.
#Come on, {NICKNAME}! Let's go take a look around that windmill!

flow.stepDescription: Look for the location in the riddle

dialogs.text: If I'm right, the location described by the clue is the windmill the furthest away from the statue... I'm not completely certain though.

flow.stepDescription: Find the location of the buried treasure
Solve the mystery (Go to Kaeya at the Knights of Favonius HQ for a hint)

dialogs.text: "She doesn't love him at all. The passion rushing through the clear spring is just a front. When she's cold and alone, her true heart is revealed."
Any idea what that means?
Is this some page stripped from a love novel that you just happened to find?
Oh, so it's not a clue. No wonder someone as clever as Paimon wasn't able to get it.
Hahaha... I'm just joking.
Hmph... Take this more seriously, Kaeya!
Haha, this riddle is hard to figure out. Clear spring... Is it referring to Springvale?
Maybe when there are people bathing in the spring water?
When the water level changes?
"Passion rushing through the clear spring..." So when does passion rush through a clear spring?
Such inappropriate behavior... I feel like it has been creeping into Mondstadt for quite a while now.
Unless... that's something you two get up to?
Oh, my apologies. I shouldn't judge what one does in their own time.
What's wrong with you? What kind of people do you think we are?
Hmm... Maybe it's when the water level of the clear spring changes?
Haha. The thing is, if the "rushing passion" isn't coming from the clear spring, then it's coming from the people bathing.
Not a bad idea! Like when... there's a waterfall, for example...
It appears the solution to this enigma relates to the waterfall behind Springvale.
Only the clear spring that blesses Mondstadt can reveal the passion described here.
And the "heart" of the waterfall must refer to the cliff on the left side of the waterfall. I noticed it once when I was out on patrol in the area.
The ending, "cold and alone," probably has something to do with Cryo, which can be controlled by a Vision.
Thanks for the help, Kaeya.
You should probably <color=#00E1FFFF>take someone who can manipulate Cryo with you</color>.
It's nothing. If a Knight of Favonius couldn't even answer a riddle, how could we be trusted to solve criminal mysteries?
Let's go take a look in Springvale. We'll leave you to your "criminal mysteries"!
Erm...
No, wait... Leave you to SOLVING your criminal mysteries!

flow.stepDescription: Look for the location in the riddle

dialogs.text: Take a look around the waterfall near Springvale. Remember to bring a friend who can manipulate Cryo. Huh? Oh... Me?
The location is in the Whispering Woods — you haven't forgotten, right?
